<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="16"> <diagram name="Página-1" id="lI_XaFx-jYAMKxobDn5b"> <mxGraphModel dx="562" dy="1199" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1169" pageHeight="827" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
skinparam packageStyle rectangle
skinparam nodesep 90
skinparam ranksep 90
skinparam Padding 6

' Deixa as linhas e bordas mais escuras e nítidas no draw.io
skinparam ArrowColor #222222
skinparam ArrowThickness 1.6
skinparam ArrowFontColor #111111
skinparam ArrowFontSize 12
skinparam ClassBorderColor #222222
skinparam ClassBorderThickness 1.5

' Destaque visual para Hot Spots e Instâncias do Framework
skinparam class {
 BackgroundColor<<hot spot>> #FFF3CD
 BorderColor<<hot spot>> #D39E00
 BackgroundColor<<template method>> #E2F0D9
 BorderColor<<template method>> #548235
 BackgroundColor<<instance>> #E8F4FD
 BorderColor<<instance>> #2E75B6
}

package \"store.application (Frozen Spot)\" {

 class StoreService <<template method>> {
 - storeRepository : StoreRepository
 - ordersInProgressCounter : OrdersInProgressCounter
 - storeCapacityPolicy : StoreCapacityPolicy
 + getStore() : StoreOutput
 + updateSettings(input : UpdateStoreSettingsInput) : StoreOutput
 + updateStatusManually(input : UpdateStoreStatusInput) : StoreOutput
 + clearManualStatus() : StoreOutput
 + refreshAutomaticStatuses(currentTime : LocalTime) : void
 }
}

package \"store.domain (Core & Hot Spot 4)\" {

 package \"repositories & ports\" {
 interface StoreRepository {
 + save(store : Store) : Store
 + getDefaultStore() : Optional<Store>
 }

 interface OrdersInProgressCounter {
 + countOrdersInProgress() : int
 }

 StoreRepository -[hidden]right-> OrdersInProgressCounter
 }

 package \"model & hot spot\" {
 class Store {
 - id : Long
 - name : String
 - openingTime : LocalTime
 - closingTime : LocalTime
 - maxOrdersInProgress : int
 - automaticPause : boolean
 - status : StoreStatus
 - manualStatus : StoreStatus
 - addressStreet : String
 - addressNumber : String
 - addressNeighborhood : String
 - addressCity : String
 - addressZipCode : String
 + updateSettings(openingTime : LocalTime, closingTime : LocalTime, maxOrdersInProgress : int, automaticPause : boolean) : void
 + setManualStatus(status : StoreStatus) : void
 + clearManualStatus() : void
 + refreshAutomaticStatus(currentTime : LocalTime, ordersInProgress : int) : boolean
 }

 enum StoreStatus {
 ABERTA
 FECHADA
 PAUSADA
 }

 interface StoreCapacityPolicy <<hot spot>> {
 + canAcceptOrder(store : Store, currentOrdersInProgress : int) : boolean
 }

 Store -left-> StoreStatus : status / manualStatus >
 Store <-right- StoreCapacityPolicy : avalia capacidade >
 }
}

package \"instances.store (Especializações do Hot Spot 4)\" {

 class BurgerCapacityPolicy <<instance>> {
 + canAcceptOrder(store : Store, currentOrdersInProgress : int) : boolean
 --
 Regra: Pausa automática ao atingir limite simultâneo da cozinha (maxOrdersInProgress)
 }

 class PharmaCapacityPolicy <<instance>> {
 + canAcceptOrder(store : Store, currentOrdersInProgress : int) : boolean
 --
 Regra: Valida limite diário do laboratório e presença de prescrição/RT
 }

 class PcBuilderCapacityPolicy <<instance>> {
 + canAcceptOrder(store : Store, currentOrdersInProgress : int) : boolean
 --
 Regra: Controle por horas-homem de bancada técnica disponível
 }

 BurgerCapacityPolicy -up.|> StoreCapacityPolicy
 PharmaCapacityPolicy -up.|> StoreCapacityPolicy
 PcBuilderCapacityPolicy -up.|> StoreCapacityPolicy

 BurgerCapacityPolicy -[hidden]right-> PharmaCapacityPolicy
 PharmaCapacityPolicy -[hidden]right-> PcBuilderCapacityPolicy
}

' Relacionamentos Application -> Ports
StoreService -down-> StoreRepository
StoreService -down-> OrdersInProgressCounter

' Alinhamento vertical limpo entre Repositório/Port e Modelo/Hot Spot
StoreRepository -down-> Store : persiste >
OrdersInProgressCounter -[hidden]down-> StoreCapacityPolicy

@enduml
